# Z-One Studios

> Z-One (also known as Z One, Zone, Z-One Studios, Z One Studios) is a web development and 3D design agency based in Srinagar, Kashmir, India.

## About
Z-One is a small, senior-only web development agency that specializes in building custom websites, immersive 3D web experiences using Three.js and WebGL, and full-stack platforms for startups and businesses. The agency was founded by a team of young developers and designers from Kashmir who handle everything from frontend design to backend infrastructure.

## Services
- Custom Website Development
- 3D Website Development (Three.js, WebGL)
- Startup MVP Development
- UI/UX Design
- Full-Stack Web Applications
- Brand Identity & Design

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Astro
- 3D & Motion: Three.js, WebGL, GSAP, Framer Motion, Lottie
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Supabase, GraphQL
- Database: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
- Deployment: Vercel, Render, Docker

## Projects
- Kashmir Heal: Healthcare telemedicine platform for Kashmir
- Mines: Vintage-style marketplace and probability game
- Apple Haven: Mountain cabin bookings and real estate in Kashmir
- Portfolio of Jay: Personal developer portfolio
- Headshot Paintball: Sports and entertainment booking platform
- IDPS Mahore (idpsmahore.net): Completed institutional website
